---
title: "Sponsorship"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(gt)
library(readr)
read_csv("resources/sponsorship.csv") |> 
  gt() |> 
  sub_missing(
    columns = everything(),
    rows = everything(),
    missing_text = ""
    ) |>
  opt_row_striping(row_striping = FALSE) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(16)
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Benefits) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(17)),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )
```
